910191.desc: Slightly increase velocity when positioned midpack or further back on a mid-race corner and there are at least 3 runners nearby.

910201.name: Break It Down!
910201.desc: Slightly increase velocity when positioned toward the front on a late-race straight. If it's the backstretch, also minimally increase acceleration.

910211.name: Lightning Flare
910211.desc: Very slightly increase velocity continuously when the skill user activates 2 skills mid-race. Increase this skill's effectiveness if the user activates another skill while it's active (up to 2 times).

910221.name: Best day ever
910221.desc: If well-positioned late-race on the final corner or later, slightly increase velocity. If there's a large distance left to the finish, also increase acceleration very minimally.

910231.name: Presents from X
910231.desc: Slightly increase velocity mid-race after staying well-positioned from the start of the race up until the second half.

910241.name: Flowery☆Maneuver
910241.desc: Slightly increase velocity when passing another runner toward the front on the final corner or later. If passing toward the back, slightly increase acceleration instead.

910261.name: Operation Cacao
910261.desc: Take a minimal breather and slightly increase velocity when in the front part of the pack and there's another runner coming from behind on a corner mid-race.

910301.name: Every Rose Has Its Fangs
910301.desc: Slightly drain endurance from runners in front and very slightly increase velocity when well-positioned mid-race.

910341.name: Firelight
910341.desc: Slightly increase velocity on the final straight after pressuring a runner toward the back on a corner late-race. Effect increases for each time the user passed a runner on a corner late-race.

910351.name: Ticket to Your Dreams!
910351.desc: Very slightly increase velocity steadily when in midpack or further back on the final straight in the last spurt. Effect increases when activating a skill (up to 3 times).

910371.name: Guten Appetit ♪
910371.desc: Slightly increase velocity continuously on the final straight if the skill user passed another runner at least 2 times on the final corner or later.

910381.name: One True Color
910381.desc: If positioned toward the front with 350m remaining and there is another Umamusume close behind, break out of the pack slightly more easily.

910401.name: Dancing in the Leaves
910401.desc: Very slightly increase ability to break out of the pack when engaged in a challenge in midpack on the final corner.

910451.name: Give Mummy a Hug ♡
910451.desc: Very slightly increase ability to break out of the pack when well-positioned and close to the runner ahead on the final straight.

910461.name: α-star*
910461.desc: Very slightly increase velocity steadily when positioned toward the lead around halfway through the race. Also very slightly recover endurance if it's a dirt race.

910501.name: Hephaestus
910501.desc: Slightly increase velocity from midpack upon approaching the final straight late-race.

910521.name: 114th Time's the Charm
910521.desc: Give max effort when far from the lead on the final corner, very slightly increasing velocity steadily for a duration proportional to distance from the lead.

910561.name: Bountiful Harvest
910561.desc: Slightly increase velocity with a surge of fortune when pressured by another runner toward the back in the second half of the race.

910581.name: Spooky, Scary, Happy
910581.desc: Slightly increase velocity and very minimally intimidate up to 2 runners ahead and up to 2 runners behind when positioned toward the front upon entering the final straight.

910591.name: Wherever This Wonder Leads
910591.desc: If positioned midpack on a downhill just before late-race and there's a large distance left to the finish, slightly increase velocity.

910601.name: Go☆Go☆Goal!
910601.desc: If the user passed another runner on the final corner or later, slightly increase velocity from the midpack onward on the final straight. If the user isn't one of the top favorites, keep steadily increasing velocity slightly.

910611.name: Louder! Tracen Cheer!
910611.desc: If the user stayed toward the very back during the first half of the race without being rushed, slightly increase acceleration on the final straight.

920011.name: Dreams Donned with Pride!
920011.desc: If the user activates another skill on the final corner late-race, very slightly increase velocity. If racing at Nakayama Racecourse, moderately increase velocity instead.

920131.name: Your Smile Sparkles as the Waves
920131.desc: When positioned in the front part of the pack in the second half of the race, start a long spurt based on remaining endurance, minimally increasing velocity continuously.
